summary: Read and write a FreeVectorIcons design collection: briefs, DESIGN.md, icons and brand assets.
description: Connect your agent to a FreeVectorIcons design collection: read the brief and DESIGN.md, search and fetch icons and brand assets, and save work back as versions.
suggestedPrompts: Read my FreeVectorIcons collection brief and DESIGN.md, then summarise the brand rules
Find icons in my collection for a settings page and add them to this component
Save this SVG to my collection as a new version of the existing logo

env.name: FVI_TOKEN
env.title: Collection token
env.description: Collection-scoped token (fvi_col_…) from FreeVectorIcons → your collection → Integrations → Setup MCP. The collection is derived from this token. Never commit this value.

env.name: FVI_API_URL
env.title: API base URL
env.description: API origin including /api. Leave the default for production.

env.name: FVI_READ_ONLY
env.title: Read only
env.description: Set true to hide write tools (park, upload, version).
